# Dharmendra Awasthi

> Lead Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, and Software Developer with 9+ years of experience specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, AWS, and Microservices Architecture.

## Professional Summary
Senior Software Engineer with **nearly 10 years of experience** designing and building scalable, high-performance distributed systems and cloud-native microservices across telecom, retail, fintech, and gaming domains. Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS, and event-driven architectures. Proven track record of delivering highly available platforms processing over **1,500 TPS** and serving **10M+ users**. Experienced in leading end-to-end system design (HLD/LLD), driving technical architecture, and **leading and mentoring a team of four software engineers** to successfully deliver complex, high-impact projects from conception to production.
